dimensions.label: Problem Clarity
dimensions.evidence: The primary user is a single store operator who loses hours during recurring catalog updates and sometimes ships bad variant, price, or SKU data through Godaddy's painful catalog workflow.

dimensions.label: Goal Definition
dimensions.evidence: Phase 1 is correctness-first: routine catalog updates should no longer require hand-editing CSVs, and preventable import mistakes should be eliminated in the normal workflow.

dimensions.label: Success Criteria
dimensions.evidence: Done is defined by representative round-trip tests, blocked invalid exports, project-file persistence checks, and variant-completion SKU tests.

dimensions.label: Scope Boundaries
dimensions.evidence: MVP is a localhost catalog editor with safe CSV round-trip, project-file persistence, validation, and missing-combination generation; images, bulk authoring, and AI are explicitly deferred by tier.

dimensions.label: Consistency
dimensions.evidence: The SKU tension is resolved: existing SKUs remain unchanged, while only newly generated variants receive inferred or fallback-generated SKUs.

problem: A single operator maintains a Godaddy merch catalog through a workflow that is slow, brittle, and biased toward mistakes. The painful parts are not checkout or storefront concerns; they are catalog-maintenance concerns: variant combinations, prices, option values, and SKU correctness.

The current Godaddy flow forces the operator too close to a vendor-specific CSV shape. That means routine updates consume hours, missing variant combinations are hard to reason about, and bad edits can leak into customer-facing catalog data.

The product needs to make normal catalog maintenance safe enough that the operator no longer hand-edits CSV files for routine work, while still preserving the exact data Godaddy depends on when existing variants are re-exported.
goals: Eliminate preventable import mistakes in the normal catalog-maintenance workflow by blocking invalid exports before they reach Godaddy.
Make the localhost app the normal editing surface for routine catalog updates so the operator no longer needs to hand-edit the Godaddy CSV for ordinary changes.
Support completing existing products by defining allowed option sets and generating missing variant combinations without breaking existing SKU identity.

successCriteria.criterion: A representative Godaddy catalog can be imported, edited, exported, and re-imported without corrupting product-to-variant relationships, prices, option values, or existing SKU identity.
The app blocks export when structural catalog mistakes would make the output unsafe, including broken variant relationships, duplicate SKUs, or incomplete required option data.

An operator can define allowed option sets for an existing product and generate the missing variant combinations while preserving all pre-existing SKUs and assigning inferred or fallback SKUs only to the new variants.
Edits survive between sessions through an explicit local project-file save/load workflow rather than requiring one uninterrupted editing session.
A routine catalog update can be completed in the app without hand-editing the raw Godaddy CSV.
successCriteria.check: Judgment call — walk a representative update from import through export without opening the CSV in an editor

mvp.item: Import a Godaddy CSV into a cleaner internal catalog model

mvp.item: Save and load a local project file between sessions
mvp.reason: Session-only editing would make the workflow too fragile for real catalog work

mvp.item: Localhost web app for editing existing products and variants, including prices, option values, and SKU fields
mvp.reason: The primary user needs a safe day-to-day editing surface for an existing catalog

mvp.item: Define allowed option sets for an existing product and generate missing variant combinations
mvp.reason: Closing catalog gaps is a core pain point, not a later optimization

mvp.item: Preserve existing SKUs exactly while inferring or generating SKUs only for newly created variants
mvp.reason: This preserves catalog identity while removing the manual work of filling missing combinations

mvp.item: Pre-export validation that blocks unsafe exports
mvp.reason: Correctness-first MVP requires guardrails, not just transformation

mvp.item: Export a Godaddy-compatible CSV that round-trips safely
mvp.reason: CSV remains the only approved bridge to Godaddy in this plan

full.reason: This is the nearest adjacent workflow once structured catalog data is safe

full.reason: Once the single-product workflow is correct, repetitive catalog work becomes the next speed bottleneck

full.item: Create new products and product families from scratch
full.reason: This expands the tool from maintenance into fuller catalog authoring
